name: Nordic Entity Registry Integration
description: Live Swedish company registry, beneficial ownership chains, and sanctions screening via Roaring API. Covers SE, NO, FI, DK entities. Data is fetched on-demand at session time — not stored in the pack.

attributes.coverage: Swedish registered entities + UBO chains up to 5 levels

attributes.obligation: Obliged entities must apply CDD measures when establishing business relationships, including verification of identity and beneficial ownership.
attributes.roaring_mapping: Roaring company lookup + UBO chain directly satisfies Art. 12(1)(b) — verification of beneficial owner identity

entities.name: AMLR Article 22 — Enhanced Due Diligence for PEPs

attributes.obligation: Obliged entities must apply EDD to customers who are PEPs or whose beneficial owner is a PEP.
attributes.roaring_mapping: Roaring UBO chain includes PEP flags for each node. PEP flag = automatic Art. 22 trigger.

attributes.obligation: Obliged entities must continuously monitor business relationships and transactions.
attributes.roaring_mapping: Roaring provides periodic refresh of UBO chains and sanctions status. Changes trigger re-assessment.

prompt_injection: When activated, ANTON will automatically query Roaring for any Swedish/Nordic company mentioned in FCP module sessions. The entity profile (company details, UBO chain, sanctions status, financial risk) is injected as Layer 2c into the system prompt.
author: FutureChain AB
